cands.bio: Democrat who has represented Alabama House District 72 since November 2022. Born in Sawyerville; University of Alabama petroleum engineering graduate. His career includes work as a builder, manager and assistant pastor, plus more than 17 years as a field representative in Bibb, Greene and Hale counties.
cands.gaps: We found no record of Travis's stated positions or actions on data centers, homestead property taxes, limits on out-of-state or foreign land buyers, growth limits, immigration enforcement or H-1B, donor money, policing, guns, abortion, or school choice and teacher pay. His campaign platform covers education, Highway 69 widening, fiber internet, roads and bridges, job creation, Medicaid expansion and rural sewer treatment, but none of it speaks directly to those topics. Ballotpedia's list of bills he sponsored was empty in the page we read, so we could not cite any sponsored legislation. He did not complete Ballotpedia's candidate survey in 2022 or 2026, and Ballotpedia lists no endorsements for him in 2026. We found no documented controversies or foreign ties. His campaign site gives his work history in his own words and mentions additional graduate work in environmental engineering, but we could not confirm a completed graduate degree.
